text: Acceptance 2: pending HTTP and MCP reads survive revocation. In-memory test: start longPollHandler(wait=300), revoke its bearer, then post => authenticatedNow=false, status=200, private body delivered; disable/password-change variants also leaked. MCP talk_read reproduced tokenValid=false, delivered=true (server.ts:1323). Retain credential context, reauthenticate before delivery, and cancel invalidated waits.
